examples.question: Do they carry over?
examples.answer:
Based on the provided documents, the answer depends on whether you are a full-time employee under the standard PTO policy or an employee under the Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy.

For **full-time employees**, unused Paid Time Off (PTO) up to 5 days may be carried into the next calendar year; anything above 5 days is forfeited on December 31.
For employees under the **Flexible Time Off (FTO)** policy, there is no balance, so there is nothing to carry over and no payout on exit (except where local law requires it).
